title: Anabol Segment Index
description: Maps each merged sub-skill to its category skill, line range, and anchor so the orchestrator can read only the needed segment.

generatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last (re)index run.

structureRoot.description: Absolute path to the skill structure root this index describes.

id.description: Unique sub-skill id (kebab-case), unique across the whole index.

category.description: Category skill the sub-skill was merged into (also its directory name).

file.description: Path to the category SKILL.md holding this segment, relative to structureRoot.

endLine.description: 1-based last line of the segment (inclusive). endLine >= startLine.

anchor.description: Unique literal text (a heading) found within the segment; used to re-locate it if lines shift.

description.description: One-line routing description the orchestrator uses to pick a segment.

keywords.description: Frequent body tokens captured at merge time; used by `find` to route terse descriptions without reading the body.

assets.description: Files shipped with the original skill, copied next to the category (structure-relative paths). Relative references in the body are rewritten to these paths.

path.description: Original SKILL.md path in the source package.
